candidates.title: Anne Imhof: House of Swans
candidates.blurb: Imhof's durational performance architecture arrives in Asia, translating her endurance aesthetics into the former colonial prison complex.

candidates.title: Alicja Kwade: Waiting Pavilions
candidates.blurb: Kwade's temporal sculptures occupy the prison yard, continuing her investigation of perception and philosophical materialism in contested space.

candidates.title: Ancient Egypt Unveiled: Treasures from Egyptian Museums
candidates.blurb: HKPM extends its non-Chinese antiquities programme with direct loans from Egyptian state collections, testing its museological range.

candidates.title: Treasures of Global Jewellery from The Metropolitan Museum of Art: The Body Transformed
candidates.blurb: Met's jewellery holdings tour Asia, positioning HKPM as regional hub for Western museum partnerships outside traditional Sino-centric narrative.

candidates.title: Wonders of Imperial Carpets: Masterpieces from the Museum of Islamic Art, Doha
candidates.blurb: Doha's Islamic textile collection lands in Hong Kong, signaling Gulf-Asia cultural diplomacy through decorative arts.

candidates.title: The Forbidden City and The Palace of Versailles: China-France Cultural Encounters in the Seventeenth and Eighteenth Centuries
candidates.blurb: Dual-court comparison traces Sino-French exchange when both empires operated through parallel absolutist aesthetics and diplomatic gifting protocols.

candidates.title: A History of China in Silk: The Chris Hall Collection at the Hong Kong Palace Museum
candidates.blurb: Private Western collector's Chinese textiles enter public display, tracing how silk formed a material archive outside state control.

candidates.title: Proudly from Canton: The Muwen Tang Collection of Cantonese and Export Art
candidates.blurb: Hong Kong museum spotlights Cantonese production for foreign markets, recuperating a local manufacturing history distinct from imperial taste.
candidates.why_shortlisted: Regional identity assertion through trade goods

candidates.title: Fermata: Hong Kong in Venice
candidates.blurb: Hong Kong's Biennale collateral returns home; worth seeing if it offers genuine reflection rather than victory lap.

candidates.title: Live: Hong Kong Art Exhibition
candidates.blurb: HKMA surveys local contemporary practice; success depends on whether curatorial framing acknowledges recent decades' cultural recalibration.
